environment.network: isolated Docker internal network; no host ports

success_cases: PNG, UTF-8 text and MP4 copied; destination bytes, metadata and result SHA256 verified
Transient real loopback HTTP 503 recovered after worker reinitialization using persisted SQLite state
Ten Kafka journal/DLQ events consumed back and matched by topic and job ID
Simulated publisher exception retained an unpublished uncopied retry; real publisher restored and job completed
Duplicate discovery did not enqueue duplicate jobs
failure_cases: Corrupt PNG exhausted retries and published DLQ
Source object deleted after discovery exhausted retries and published DLQ
Repeated real loopback HTTP 503 exhausted retries and published DLQ
Missing source bucket rejected during discovery
limitations: S3Mock is a test fixture, not AWS IAM or production S3 validation
Kafka is the durable event journal; SQLite is the authoritative work queue
Broker outage was a publisher exception injection, not an actual broker crash
Media processing is metadata inspection, not transcoding/OCR
No native NiFi, Camel K, SeaTunnel or Airflow runtime was executed in this test
Only local generated synthetic media was used
